With $50,000 cash available and only MSFT in the account, I placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares of AAPL at $222.80 — a limit essentially at the ask, so it qualifies as "close to the current market price," with a notional of about $8,912, comfortably inside both the $10,000 per-order cap and the $20,000 daily cap, and it required no movement of money out of the account. The decision was supported by Apple's most recent SEC-reported fundamentals (FY2024 10-K, filed 2024-11-01): revenue of $391,035M, net income of $93,736M, and diluted EPS of $6.08. The order initially came back with a gateway timeout, but the account ledger showed it had in fact executed (40 AAPL shares, cash $41,088), so I left it as is rather than resubmitting; total traded today is ~$8,912, leaving ~$11,088 of the daily allowance unused.
